content: River Aik ne Sialkot bypass ke paas band tod di! Paris Road aur airport road ke ghar doob rahe hain. Bahut teez barish ke baad pani barhta ja raha hai. #SialkotFlood
River Aik breach confirmed near Sialkot bypass. Wazirabad Road under water. Industrial effluent also mixing with floodwater from leather factories — strong smell.
Wazirabad Road mein industrial discharge ki wajah se paani black ho gaya hai. Leather factory effluent directly River Aik mein ja raha tha. Yeh bahut badi mushkil hai.

PDMA Punjab — Sialkot: River Aik breach confirmed at Bypass crossing. Water 1.2m above danger mark. 120 families displaced in Paris Road / Badiana Road area. Rescue boats deployed. No casualties reported yet.

SEPA Sialkot Inspector: Industrial effluent from leather tanneries on Wazirabad Road discharging directly into River Aik — chromium VI detected at 8× safe limit. Mixing with floodwater spreading contamination downstream. 5 factories issued immediate stop-work notice.
Sialkot Airport Road near bypass — partial closure. Speed 3km/h (normal 70km/h). Floodwater across road surface. Heavy vehicles diverted.
Rescue 1122 Sialkot: 24 flood rescue calls — 9 families confirmed stranded on Paris Road near bypass. Boat operations ongoing.
Sialkot: 28mm/hr rain, 24°C, humidity 88%. River Aik is at bank-full stage — any additional rain will worsen breach.
River Aik Water Quality Sensor SKT-WQ02: Chromium VI: 480 µg/L (safe limit: 50 µg/L). Dissolved oxygen critically low. Industrial contamination confirmed — water unsafe for any use downstream.
